cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values "s01" through "s08", while needs/coverage records use "n06-r01" through "n06-r08".
Observed Job 2 priorities all have "upstream_rank": 0, showing provenance ranks were not matched to downstream record IDs.

upstream_demand_provenance.py assemble_provenance appends {"record_id": record.get('source_id', ""), "source_id": record.get("source_id", ""), ...}, changing the provenance record identity from the need record_id to the source_id.
Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id and deterministic source provenance identities, weights, and demand-descending rank order.
initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains an upstream provenance fault. Job 1's evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values, so Job 2 cannot join provenance ranks back to need record IDs and emits upstream_rank 0 for every priority. The supplied source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which sets "record_id" from record.get('source_id', "") instead of preserving the need record_id. Job 2 consumed the supplied handoffs and its all-zero upstream_rank values are a downstream symptom of the malformed evidence_sources handoff.
